objective.statement: On HomeView, show the text "ADA plugin test" centered horizontally and vertically inside the red bordered div.

complexity.rationale: One localized JSX/class change in a single view; no contracts, state or approval-boundary work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The red bordered div in HomeView.tsx contains the text "ADA plugin test".
The text is aligned horizontally and vertically within the div.

in.statement: src/views/home/HomeView.tsx, plus its colocated component test and test-id constants.

out.statement: Changing the div's size, border or position; other views or components.

observations.statement: "Size 8" is interpreted as font-size 8px (text-[8px]); Tailwind has no built-in size 8 text class.
The red bordered div is the aria-label="Red bordered square" element, 200px square with border-red-500.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Static presentational text; no state needed.

component.rationale: Rendered text and centering classes are component behavior.

integration.rationale: No cross-module flow changes; npm run test is run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Static text with no user flow; component test covers it.

increments.behavior: HomeView renders "ADA plugin test" centered at 8px inside the red bordered div.
increments.doneWhen: t-1 passes and the full test suite stays green.

tests.description: HomeView shows "ADA plugin test" inside the red bordered div, centered both ways, at 8px.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Red bordered div has no text content / no centering classes.
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: 3 of 3 tests failed: unable to find element with data-id home-view-red-bordered-square (div has no data-id, text or centering classes).

verification.requirement: npm run test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
verification.command: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
verification.result: 7/7 tests pass (3 files), lint clean, build ok
